core_scope: numbered chapters1–13 only; amendments14–15 excluded and require separate demonstrated-dependency checklist
limits: Mechanical extraction is not a normative-requirement count or semantic completeness proof.
Each prose/grammar/table block may contain multiple obligations; rows need manual decomposition during review.
Clause gates explicitly retain property-attribute, realm and dependency obligations not mechanically separable.
Nested step labels follow rendered ecmarkup numeric/alpha/roman cycle; counts cross-checked against all active algorithm list items.
Snapshot contains inserted/deleted amendment markup; deleted text excluded, inserted text included.
Unclassified text rows remain explicit review obligations, not silently dropped.
Snapshot is pinned Nov21; live TOC rechecked Nov22 separately, full-body future changes require regeneration.
status_note: unreconciled means review evidence not yet entered into this register, not missing implementation. existing_evidence_pending preserves current audit references; reviewed/conditional record exact local-step reconciliation, not whole-method compliance.

existing_evidence_reconciliation.scope: Only existing GetDifferenceSettings and DifferenceTemporalPlainYearMonth numbered maps; no new implementation analysis

status_definitions.unreviewed: Evidence not reconciled; not implementation missing/broken
status_definitions.reviewed: Exact local step/source correspondence reviewed under explicit recorded preconditions; not verified whole operation
status_definitions.conditional: Mapped, with named unresolved caller/provider/rounding/realm premise
status_definitions.partial: Only part of clause gate reconciled

existing_evidence_reconciliation.verification_note: Existing working polyfill remains baseline; local reviewed steps do not erase conditional premises or verify complete methods

implementation_status_note: present records a source binding or helper correspondence, not verified behavior. mapping_unresolved never means implementation missing.
fix_status_note: not_reconciled preserves historical corrections and in-progress PRs for row-level import; it does not mean no defects or no fixes exist. Current fixes and validation remain in the linked audit ledger.

status_definitions.verified_local_step: Exact local source requirement reviewed under explicit callee contracts; no transitive caller closure implied.
status_definitions.verified: Assigned clause-local contract closed; cross-referenced target chapters do not inherit credit.
status_definitions.conditional: Named remaining premise in review_evidence; mapped code remains implemented.
status_definitions.informative: Introduction/cross-reference/note with no independent normative obligation; not compliance credit.
status_definitions.unreconciled: Evidence not yet reconciled, not missing implementation.
status_definitions.existing_evidence_pending: Prior evidence preserved, exact row reconciliation pending.
status_definitions.spec_issue: Existing published inconsistency, including propagated gates; recorded separately from implementation defects.

latest_numbered_pass.gap_state: Duration comparison boundary branch failures reproduced and corrected; calendar/realm/parser/window premises retained.

numbered_pass_totals.note: Every fixed core row reconciled; local proofs, informative/editorial rows, conditional premises and standards issues remain distinct. First pass is not full compliance.

latest_correction_reconciliation.validation: 12 targets pass; final host species/typecheck2pass; preceding regression failures reproduced
latest_correction_reconciliation.scope: Local leaves and fully reconciled style gates only; reader iteration, provider contracts and published issues preserved.
